name: Finnhub
rate_limits: 30 calls a second on every plan, on top of each plan's own limit (source: https://finnhub.io/docs/api/rate-limit). The free plan's per minute cap was not readable on the pricing page today.
what_it_has: A free market news feed with a forex category. Forex candles, all forex rates and the economic calendar are marked Premium, and historical calendar surprises are Enterprise only.
simple: A data company whose free plan gives live market headlines, but currency prices and the economic calendar cost money.
license_terms: Free plan is for personal use; see Finnhub terms. https://finnhub.io/terms-of-service
quality_notes: Premium flags read from Finnhub's own API spec (swagger.json). News history depth for backtests is unknown.

relevance.reason: Fine for a live headline feed, not for FX prices or backtests.
